name: Nikos Star-Lance
passives: Laurel Supremacy — Nikos's Mastery: Nikos's Laurel Glory: a solo execution chain that grows when the Titan uses high ground and duel circles to control enemies instead of relying on allies. Counterplay remains: deny favored terrain, force reaction bait, drain Momentum or Divinity.
lore: Nikos Star-Lance is a colossal Olympian disruptor from The Celestial Heights of Olympus. Humans later copied fragments of this being into myth, ritual, monster lore, and sacred art, but the Titan is the older source: Olympian disruptor office: necessary chaos, storm/curse interference, enemy order severance; Ares/Nike: war fury and victory personified.
personality: Ancient, immense, purposeful, and bound to the survival philosophy of its Realm.
visualDescription: Full-body living myth-source Titan, not a costume: Nikos Star-Lance shows living marble-light bodies, bronze cuirasses, laurel circuits, aegis scales, thunder tribunal halos, oracle smoke, amphitheater armor curves, hoplite shield geometry, winged victory accents, gold-blue skyfire, carved but non-readable relief bands.. Role silhouette must read as Disruptor. Materials include living white marble, warm bronze, laurel green, aegis scale gold, storm blue, oracle violet smoke, ambrosial ivory. The design must feel older than human mythology and avoid generic toga costume, Roman gladiator confusion, marble statue stiffness, robot bronze automaton, sci-fi halo, neon arena grid.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, named gear, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Nikos Null Strike
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Ichor damage at range 3; gain 8 Momentum, or 12 if used from honor-marked terrain or into the Titan's marked target.
abilityDetails.counterplay: Line-of-sight denial, evasion, armor, or forcing low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Summit Rite Severance
abilityDetails.effect: Apply cast interrupt, meter drain, reaction lockout; also builds 10 Laurel Glory when it changes enemy intent or breaks an objective action.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Nikos Star-Lance: Interdiction Decree
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Laurel Glory to create a two-round battlefield rule around honor-marked terrain; enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum, or trigger the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Summit Ichor Unbound
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: +15% damage, +12 mitigation, empowered Laurel Glory, and one mythic reaction override. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Olympian Summit Implement
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Empowered basics against vulnerable enemies generate +4 Momentum but cannot trigger more than once per round.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action generation; damage bonus capped against bosses.

equipmentDetails.name: Nikos Star-Lance Realmplate
equipmentDetails.effect: +1 armor and +2 resistance. First preventable hazard hit each battle is reduced by 25% if the Titan used a reaction last round.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Hazard reduction does not prevent scripted boss mechanics.

equipmentDetails.name: Nikos Laurel Glory Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Laurel Glory cap +20. At 80+ Laurel Glory, the next Technique gains a role-specific rider, then drains 30 Laurel Glory.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: One empowered Technique per two rounds; cannot chain with Ascension opener.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every Titan can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: interrupt resources, casts, reactions, and elite mechanics
